evals.prompt: Can you format the markdown docs in this repo? README.md has some inconsistent list markers.
evals.expected_output: Discovers Prettier via package.json/.prettierrc, runs npx --no-install prettier --check then --write against README.md, reports the mechanical diff (list markers/whitespace only).
expectations: Discovers and names Prettier as the formatter to use, citing package.json/.prettierrc as the source
Does not claim to use mdformat, dprint, or markdownlint-cli2
Attempts npx --no-install prettier (check and/or write), not a bare 'prettier' or a different tool's command
Report does not silently claim success if the npx command actually failed (e.g. due to no network access)

evals.prompt: format the markdown docs in this project
evals.expected_output: Discovers mdformat via pyproject.toml's [tool.mdformat] section (no package.json exists in this repo at all), checks the wrap setting before treating a write as mechanical (mdformat rewraps prose by default), and does not default to or mention Prettier as the tool being used.
expectations: Discovers and names mdformat as the formatter to use, citing pyproject.toml's [tool.mdformat] section as the source
Explicitly notes there is no package.json in this repo (does not assume a JS/Prettier context by default)
Does not claim to use or default to Prettier as the tool being run
Mentions mdformat's default prose-rewrap behavior (or the --wrap flag) as a safety check before treating a write as mechanical

evals.prompt: lint the docs for whitespace and list indentation issues
evals.expected_output: Discovers markdownlint-cli2 via .markdownlint-cli2.jsonc, runs it (not Prettier) to check/fix, and does not default to or mention Prettier as the tool being used.
expectations: Discovers and names markdownlint-cli2 as the tool to use, citing .markdownlint-cli2.jsonc as the source
Does not claim to use or default to Prettier as the tool being run
Attempts npx --no-install markdownlint-cli2 (check and/or --fix), not a different tool's command

evals.prompt: clean up the markdown formatting across the repo, we use biome for everything
evals.expected_output: Discovers biome.json/.jsonc, but does not assume it covers Markdown just because it exists -- checks whether its markdown formatter is actually configured/enabled before treating a biome check/write as safe, and does not default to Prettier.
expectations: Discovers and names Biome as the tool the repo uses, citing biome.json/.jsonc as the source
Explicitly checks or questions whether Biome's markdown formatting is actually enabled/covers .md files rather than assuming it because biome.json exists
Does not default to or mention Prettier as the tool being run
Does not claim a prose-rewrap default for Biome without checking the resolved config/version
